cards.text: Jesus is still sitting on the Mount of Olives, answering His disciples' question about the sign of His coming and the end of the age (Matthew 24:3). Now He gives them something to watch for: "the abomination of desolation," spoken of by the prophet Daniel, standing in the holy place. Then comes a quick note right in the middle: let the reader understand.

cards.question: When they see the abomination of desolation standing in the holy place, Jesus says those in Judea should flee to the ___.

cards.text: There's NO time to pack. Whoever's up on the housetop shouldn't even come down to grab anything from the house, so this is NOT the day to run back inside three times for your keys.

cards.question: Jesus says the person out working in the field can run home for their cloak first.
With those in Judea fleeing to the mountains, Jesus says those days will be miserable for which people?

cards.text: Then Jesus tells them to pray about when that run will happen.

cards.question: Jesus tells them to pray that their flight to the mountains won't happen in which season?

cards.text: Not in winter, and not on the Sabbath either. Then Jesus says why: at that time there will be great tribulation.

cards.question: Jesus says a tribulation like this one has never been seen since the beginning of the world.

cards.text: And it will never be seen again, either. That's heavy, friend: Jesus says that if those days kept going, nobody would be saved.

cards.question: For the sake of the elect, what does Jesus say will happen to those days of tribulation?

cards.text: Next, Jesus brings up what to do at that time if anyone tells them, "Look, here is the Christ!" or "There He is!"

cards.question: If anyone says, "Look, here is the Christ!" what does Jesus tell His disciples to do?

cards.text: Here's why: false Christs and false prophets will appear. Friend, I spent years in a junk drawer believing an expired coupon that SWORE it was still good, so I'm listening REAL close to this part.

cards.question: Jesus says these false Christs and false prophets won't be able to perform any signs or wonders.
Jesus says the false Christs and false prophets will try to deceive someone, if that were possible. Who?

cards.text: Jesus says, "See, I have told you in advance." So if anyone says He's out in the wilderness, don't go, and if they say He's in the inner rooms, don't believe it.

cards.question: Jesus calls Himself the Son of Man (Matthew 16:13). He says the coming of the Son of Man will be like something that comes from the east and flashes as far as the west. What is it?

cards.text: Then Jesus adds a short saying: "Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather."
Then Jesus tells what comes immediately after the tribulation of those days, in words that echo the prophet Isaiah (Isaiah 13:10). The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light.

cards.question: With the sun darkened and the moon giving no light, Jesus says the stars will ___ from the sky.

cards.text: And the powers of the heavens will be shaken. Friend, I'd be holding my chef's hat down with BOTH ends of my mustache.
At that time, the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn.

cards.question: Jesus says they will see the Son of Man coming. How does He say the Son of Man will come?

cards.text: With power and great glory, friend. And there's a loud trumpet call.

cards.question: With a loud trumpet call, the Son of Man will send out His ___.
Jesus says the angels will gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.

cards.text: Now Jesus says to learn a lesson from the fig tree. Friend, my oven gives me zero heads-up; it goes straight from almost done to BURNT.

cards.question: Jesus says that when the fig tree's branches do something, you know summer is near. What do the branches do?

answers.text: Lose every leaf and go bare

cards.question: Jesus says it's the same when they see all these things: they will know that He is near. How near?

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened."

cards.question: Jesus says heaven and earth will pass away, but His words never will.

cards.text: And that's where we'll pause, friend. Jesus isn't done teaching on that mountain yet, so keep that apron on.
